Eat, momma's baby boy!

We go up the stairs every day, panting, to Tudor's room to weigh myself in. In the ward there were some professional electronic scales that you don't normally find for sale for the end user. Hospital lessons

Tudor's mother didn't know that obesity in children occurs by increasing the number of fat cells. In adults like me they do not multiply, they just increase in size. So when Tudor grows up he will have way more fat cells than I do, because I grew up a normal kid, exercised, so no additional fat cells formed.
